description: Retrieve flight disruption rights for a given flight. Use when needing specific rights for a disrupted flight; NOT for general compensation info. Use compensation_table instead.

arrival_delay_hours.description: arrival delay in hours, as a number

disrupted.description: disruption type: cancellation, delay, missed connection

notice_days.description: number of days notice given for disruption, as a number

name: disruption_rights

rights.description: Object containing the rights for the disrupted flight

care.description: Details about care provided during disruption

compensation.description: Details about compensation for the disruption

amount.description: The amount of compensation in the local currency

currency.description: The currency of the compensation amount

escalation_path.description: The path to escalate the disruption issue

refund.description: Indicates if a refund is available

title: Disruption rights
